subject: Reasoning
description: Mixed sequences of letters, digits and symbols — find next term, count rules, position

questions.stem: Find the next term in the series: A1, B3, C5, D7, __?
questions.explanation: Letters go A, B, C, D, E (consecutive +1). Numbers go 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 (odd numbers, AP with common difference 2). Next term = E + 9 = E9. Mental shortcut: number formula = 2n − 1 for n = 1, 2, 3 …; the 5th term is 2·5 − 1 = 9.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: In the series J2K, L4M, N6O, P8Q, __? what comes next?
questions.explanation: Each block is letterX[number]letterY where letter pairs are consecutive (J-K, L-M, N-O, P-Q, …). Pairs go: JK → LM (skip 1) → NO (skip 1) → PQ (skip 1) → next pair RS. Numbers: 2, 4, 6, 8 → +2 each → 10. Next block = R10S. Verify alphabet skips: J→L (gap K), L→N (gap M), N→P (gap O), P→R (gap Q) ✓.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: Consider the sequence: 5 K @ 8 P # 3 R 7 % L 2 A & 9 — How many digits are immediately preceded by a letter?
questions.explanation: Identify letters and digits: letters K, P, R, L, A; digits 5, 8, 3, 7, 2, 9. For each digit, check the immediate left neighbour: 5 (start), 8 (left = @), 3 (left = #), 7 (left = R ✓), 2 (left = L ✓), 9 (left = &). Two digits qualify — '7' after R and '2' after L. Count = 2.

questions.stem: Find the missing term: Z26, X24, V22, T20, __?
questions.explanation: Letters reverse from Z, with skip 1 each: Z(26) → X(24) → V(22) → T(20) → R(18). Numbers attached are alphabet positions of those letters. Next: skip U → R, position 18. So next term = R18.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.stem: What comes next in: AZ1, BY3, CX5, DW7, __?
questions.explanation: Three sub-patterns: 1st letter A, B, C, D → next E (forward). 2nd letter Z, Y, X, W → next V (backward). Numbers 1, 3, 5, 7 → next 9 (odd AP +2). So next term = EV9. Quick check: position-sums of letter pair are 1+26=27, 2+25=27, 3+24=27, 4+23=27, 5+22=27 ✓ — invariant.

questions.stem: Find the next term: B2D, F4H, J6L, N8P, __?
questions.explanation: Each block is letterX[even number]letterY. 1st letters: B, F, J, N → +4 each (B-F-J-N) → next R. 2nd letters: D, H, L, P → +4 each → next T. Numbers: 2, 4, 6, 8 → next 10. So R10T. Verify by alphabet positions: B(2)→F(6)→J(10)→N(14)→R(18) all +4 ✓; D(4)→H(8)→L(12)→P(16)→T(20) all +4 ✓.
